narrative.overview:
Every bug report and idea is a shipment with a number and a route. The board is a parcel-tracking overview, not a forum: you see where your thing is now and what the next stop is. The host surface is label stock, the host ink is label print, the host accent is the route line and the actions. Ozvi lends the scale, density, shape language, state vocabulary and the route; the host lends every colour, font and radius.

Two worlds share one token contract. A board (/[project]/*, widget, e-mails) reads only --oz-* variables injected from the host's theme.json by toCss() in packages/theme; it must feel like a page of the host product under any palette and any Google/system font, light and dark. Ozvi's own surfaces (landing, /app, legal) run the same tokens from the ozvi preset (Archivo, route blue, white stock) and add the one thing a host never gets: the signal yellow band.

Density is calm-operational: one ruled panel of rows, a right rail of route context, generous but not airy (15.5px body, 16-20px row padding). State is spoken in a fixed shape vocabulary, so the route reads in any host palette and without colour.
keyCharacteristics: Every colour, font and radius on a board comes from `--oz-*`; nothing brand-coloured is hard-coded.
The route ("trasa") is the signature: mini stop-rail in every row, dated vertical timeline on detail, lanes on the roadmap.
State never by colour alone: hollow-dotted, dot-in-ring, half, filled-check, double-ring-check, slashed.
One 1180px frame for every page; the header never moves.
Rows live inside one ruled panel, not stacked cards.
Numbers are tracking numbers: heading face, heavy, tabular figures.

rules.name: The Host Owns The Colour Rule
rules.body: On any board surface every colour, font and radius is read from `--oz-*` (or the Tailwind aliases mapped onto them in `@theme inline`). A literal hex on a board is a bug. New tokens only with schema + test in `packages/theme`.

rules.name: The Brand Stays Home Rule
rules.body: The Ozvi mark, Unbounded and the landing motion appear only on Ozvi's own surfaces, never on a host's board, widget or e-mail.

rules.name: The Shape Carries State Rule
rules.body: Stage hues are a second channel. Every status is first a shape (`StatusMark`) and a word (`STOP_LABEL`); remove the colour and the state must still read.

rules.name: The Tracking Number Rule
rules.body: Item numbers, vote counts, counts beside titles, versions and dates are figures: heading face, bold or heavier, `data-num`/`tabular-nums`. A number never sits in body weight.

rules.name: The Fixed Vocabulary Rule
rules.body: Route stops are always: ideas Navrhnuté, Plánované, Rozpracované, Vydané (off: Zamietnuté); bugs Prijaté, Potvrdené, Rozpracované, Opravené, Overené (off: Nebudeme riešiť). Read them from `STOP_LABEL`; never "V práci" or ad-hoc synonyms. Unreached stops are phrased as future ("Ďalej: …", `NEXT_HINT`).

rules.name: The Ruled Panel Rule
rules.body: Lists are one bordered surface with `divide-y` rules between rows; hover is a `--oz-wash` fill, never a lift.

rules.name: The Dashed Means Not-Yet Rule
rules.body: Dashed borders mark the unreached or the internal: the next stop on the timeline, empty states, the team-only block, internal notes. Solid means public and reached.

dos: **Do** read every board colour, font and radius from `--oz-*` or its mapped alias (`bg-surface`, `text-brand-text`, `border-line-strong`, `rounded-xl`).
**Do** show state as `StatusMark` shape + `STOP_LABEL` word; colour is the second channel.
**Do** put the route on every report: `RouteRail` in rows, `Journey` on detail, lanes on the roadmap.
**Do** wrap every page in `Page` / `.oz-frame` (1180px) so the header never moves.
**Do** render lists as rows inside one `Panel` with `divide-y`.
**Do** set numbers, counts, versions and dates as tracking numbers: heading face, bold, `data-num`.
**Do** use `--oz-accent-text` for accent-coloured text, `--oz-accent` for fills and lines.
**Do** phrase unreached stops as what will happen ("Ďalej: Opravené").
donts: **Don't** hard-code brand colours, fonts or radii on a board, widget or e-mail.
**Don't** use the Ozvi mark, Unbounded or landing motion anywhere a host's brand is shown.
**Don't** convey a status by colour alone or invent a new status mark.
**Don't** use "V práci" or any synonym for the fixed stop labels.
**Don't** stack lists as separate floating cards, or narrow a page into its own centred column off the frame.
**Don't** add shadows to rows or panels at rest; lift is reserved for popovers and the landing label.
